Mutant Feature - Digitigrade Legs.name: Mutant Feature - Digitigrade Legs
Mutant Feature - Digitigrade Legs.description:
🐾 Mutant Features: Digitigrade Legs
Legs that stand on the toes, with a high, backward-angled heel.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Mutant Feature - Digitigrade Legs.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: The legs are digitigrade: the character stands on the toes and balls of long feet, with the heel lifted high into a backward-angled joint partway up the lower leg; the thighs and knees keep their human placement. The legs follow the selected skin color, and a selected Full Fur or Full Scales feature continues down them. Footwear is custom-cut to the foot or left off.

Visual selection only: this is a permanent Mutant feature of the character's body; keep it consistent in every portrait, even when the Quirk Type is Emitter or Transformation. It adds no Quirk effect, item, license or affiliation; the character's Quirk traits decide what it can do. Two selected features for the same body part (ears, mouth, tail, wings, horns, head or full skin covering) do not stack: draw only the one whose name comes first alphabetically. A Quirkless character has no heteromorph body: if Quirkless or No Quirk was chosen, do not draw this feature.
